name: FLA_MILESTONES_INT
description: FLA_MILESTONES_INT contains lease milestones for lease, asset, payments and options.

columns.name: INTERFACE_MILESTONE_ID
columns.description: Interface lease Milestone identifier. This column constitutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MILESTONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Milestone number as generated by the system.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: MILESTONE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Milestone type as defined by the user.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the milestone as entered by the user.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source for the milestone. Sources can be Lease, Payment, Option or Asset.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Source identifier for the milestone. Values could be INTERFACE_LEASE_ID, INTERFACE_ASSET_ID, INTERFACE_PAYMENT_ID or INTERFACE_OPTION_ID.

columns.name: MILESTONE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Milestone status. Various statuses can be Open, Completed and Cancelled.

columns.name: NOTICE_DATE
columns.description: Notice date as recorded for the milestone.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: Notification frequency. Values could be One-Time, Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Yearly.

columns.name: ACTION_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Action due date as recorded for the milestone.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO_USER_NAME
columns.description: User to whom the milestone is assigned.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT or UPDATE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
